results.title: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Could Face Sales Hit Due To Memory Chip Shortage
results.description: The ongoing global chip shortage is significantly affecting the smartphone market, leading to rising device prices and potential impacts on future releases. Apple is reportedly struggling to secure enough DRAM for its upcoming iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, as it collaborates with manufacturers to address the shortage.
